name: asbuilt
description: Compare a website’s observable behavior with your intent, then review evidence and honest limitations.

interface.shortDescription: Check what your website actually does
interface.longDescription: Turn your intent into reviewable checks, run approved checks through your local AsBuilt installation, and inspect evidence. Requires Node.js 24 and a running local AsBuilt service. No hosted account is required. Browser checks never start just by installing the plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AsBuilt to turn my intended website behavior into checks. Show me the target and plan before running anything.
